findings.title: BUILD and MAINTENANCE can abandon an exhausted failed rollback through the generic BLOCKED state and then resume ordinary work or cancel terminally without restoration
findings.requirement: A failed rollback after a deployed or observed exposure must remain a protected nonterminal safety obligation until genuine restoration is independently verified; cancellation, generic resume, and cleanup must not erase the unresolved exposure. This is the same fail-closed property that §15.3.1 now defines for improvement rollback failure and is required by R-06/R-07 rollback and safe cancellation.
evidence: docs/state-transition-manifests.md B35 moves `ROLLBACK_VERIFYING -> ROLLBACK_FAILED`; B37 then moves exhausted `ROLLBACK_FAILED -> BLOCKED` with only `human disposition` and no RemediationObligation or rollback-specific coordinate.

Once B37 collapses the state to generic `BLOCKED`, B25 permits `BLOCKED -> READY_REVIEW`, B26 permits `BLOCKED -> ADMISSION_WAIT`, and B57 permits `BLOCKED -> CANCEL_REQUESTED`; B60/B61/B62 can then reach immutable `CANCELLED` after quiescence/cleanup without a verified restoration edge B34/B38.

docs/state-transition-manifests.md M26 moves `ROLLBACK_VERIFYING -> ROLLBACK_FAILED`; M28 then moves exhausted `ROLLBACK_FAILED -> BLOCKED` with only `human` and no RemediationObligation or rollback-specific coordinate.

Once M28 collapses the state to generic `BLOCKED`, M21 permits `BLOCKED -> DIAGNOSED` and M46 permits `BLOCKED -> CANCEL_REQUESTED`; M47/M48/M49 can then reach immutable `CANCELLED` without M25/M29 ever proving and sealing rollback.

By contrast, improvement IRB06 preserves the exact hazard in `REMEDIATION_WAIT`, creates a rollback-safety RemediationObligation, forbids clean/ROLLED_BACK, and requires RO09, IRB09, IRB03, and IRB07 before cleanup. The BUILD and MAINTENANCE paths reproduce none of those guards.
findings.impact: A literal implementation can lose the fact that rollback failed while external exposure remains. It can admit a new BUILD plan, restart ordinary MAINTENANCE diagnosis, or report terminal cancellation after cleanup even though the known-good state was never restored. Settling the rollback Effect only classifies the attempted rollback; it does not prove restoration. This is an unsafe terminal and resource-reuse path.
findings.required_plan_repair: Give exhausted BUILD and MAINTENANCE rollback failures distinct nonterminal remediation-wait states or equivalent orthogonal rollback coordinates. Atomically create a protected rollback-safety RemediationObligation, retain exposure/resource blocks, and exclude generic BLOCKED resume/cancel terminalization. Require obligation closure plus genuine restoration and independent verification before ROLLBACK_VERIFIED/ROLLED_BACK, and only then allow cleanup or cancellation terminality. Add exact cancellation interleavings and model witnesses for exhaustion, revocation, remediation retry, successful restoration, and permanently blocked unresolved remediation.
